description: This file defines functions to convert internal schema representations to Kubernetes OpenAPI schemas, including handling of extensions, validation, and nested schemas.

classes.name: Structural
classes.description: Represents a structural schema with properties, items, and additional properties.

classes.name: Generic
classes.description: Holds generic schema attributes like type, description, title, default, nullable.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Contains Kubernetes-specific extension flags such as preserve unknown fields, embedded resource, list map keys, list type, and map type.

classes.name: ValidationExtensions
classes.description: Holds validation extension data, such as custom validation rules.

classes.name: ValueValidation
classes.description: Encapsulates validation constraints like format, maximum, minimum, pattern, length, enum, and composite schemas.

classes.name: NestedValueValidation
classes.description: Represents nested validation schemas, combining value validation, extensions, items, and properties.

methods.name: ToKubeOpenAPI
methods.description: Converts a Structural schema to a Kubernetes OpenAPI schema.

methods.name: toKubeOpenAPI
methods.description: Converts various schema components (Generic, Extensions, ValidationExtensions, ValueValidation, NestedValueValidation) to their OpenAPI representations.
